literal: Whatever is thought, all (should be) thinking of elevation; and that, even if it fails, has the nature of non-failure.
translation: Let all your thoughts be of high aims. Even if those aims fail, such noble thinking has the nature of success.
modern: நாம் நினைப்பது எல்லாம் உயர்ந்த நோக்கங்களாகவே இருக்க வேண்டும். அந்த நோக்கங்கள் நிறைவேறாவிட்டாலும், அப்படி உயர்ந்ததை நினைப்பதே ஒரு வெற்றியாகும்.
explanation: The couplet advises that one's goals and aspirations should always be set high. The word 'உள்ளுவது' refers to what one thinks or aims for, which should always be 'உயர்வு' (elevated or noble). Even if the desired outcome is not achieved, the very act of striving for something great is an achievement in itself. Thus, maintaining high motivation has the inherent nature ('நீர்த்து') of never truly failing ('தள்ளாமை').
